status: done/frozen scoped native player-index list and roster projection
scope: Ordered host roster and stage-entry RNG snapshot; no session/lobby/allocator simulation
unresolved: Actual live online/offline join rosters, connection arrays, join/removal chronology, runtime GameStartMode/GameFunc and actual session/stage seed-state are not present in authored stage arrays; explicit snapshots required.

organizeJoinPlayerList and session/lobby protocol are not implemented; Normal online requires actual post-organize roster. Known removal predicate/call sites are documented, not replaced with guessed list ordering.
Native seed constructor is resolved, but the number/order of ALL prior RNG draws before Stage.prepare3 is outside this helper. No seed-only stage reconstruction or default RNG fallback.

Only0/1 authored shuffle/limit inputs supported; unknown values refuse. Used scratch prefix is modeled; unused static scratch tail, QList memory handles/capacity, allocation/failure side effects and native exceptions partial mutations are host-owned.
selectPlayer is read-only; it neither allocates entities/components nor increments counters/marks authored slots created. Caller supplies actual creation success/registration effects.
No changes to NativeCreationOrder, PlayerBootstrap, Population, RNG source core, factory/bridge/runtime, other existing modules, shared docs or Git.

api.initialize(gamePlayerInfos,options): Pure prepare3 limit flag + InitPlayerIndexList operations; require sceneFlags,limitPlayer0/1,shufflePlayer0/1,existingIndexList; uses explicit RNG snapshot if shuffle actually calls Next. Returns appended list, used scratch prefix, range/draw trace and post RNG snapshot.
api.selectPlayer(state,createdPlayerCount,cu: Read-only native createPlayer selection; no allocator or automatic successful-created-count increment. Returns selected arguments or native limit/missing-info skip. Unlimited out-of-range throws.
api.toBootstrapGamePlayerInfos(infos): Explicit signed-byte projection for frozen PlayerBootstrap; source GamePlayerInfo raw PlayerRef/Color bytes remain separate.
api.rngSnapshotFromNativeSeed(seed): Exact RNGSession constructor utility (signed int32) only; not automatic stage-entry state. No default seed.
api.nextRange(snapshot,min,max): Native signed int32 half-open range/rejection sampling, using verified existing source-landmine-devices.pcg32; returns raw draws and post snapshot. Equal bounds do not read RNG.

rng.sessionLocation: Frame+0xc8 globals; globals+0xb8 state qword and+0xc0 raw increment qword
rng.pcgProof: 0x1816620bc literal multiplier5851f42d4c957f2d;0x1816620d7 OR local increment1;0x1816620e0 loads OLD state; advance at0x1816620e9..f4; x=((old>>45) XOR (old>>27)) low32; rotate old>>59 at0x181662100..115. Existing Landmine.pcg32 matches this exact target, not an assumed generic RNG.
rng.incrementStorage: Raw increment can be even and remains unchanged; OR1 is local effective increment only. Constructor seed0 produces even raw increment7960286522194355700, preserved in snapshots.
rng.range: swap bounds if necessary; span uint32 upper-lower, threshold=(-span mod2^32)%span; reject draw<threshold and consume another PCG step; result lower+draw%span. Equal bounds return lower without RNG access.
rng.shuffleConsumption: n-1 range calls for n>1, ascending i1..n-1; raw draw count may exceed n-1 from rejection. No draws for shuffle0 or n<=1. Every later native RNG consumer must receive returned post-state.
rng.seedCtor: 0x1816621c0/token06000398: signextend signed-int32 seed, then two successive SplitMix64 evaluations at seed+G and seed+2G, G9e3779b97f4a7c15; factorsbf58476d1ce4e5b9 and94d049bb133111eb.
rng.stageBoundary: rngSnapshotFromNativeSeed is constructor-boundary utility only. Actual stage-entry state may have earlier draws; initialize NEVER resets to seed/defaults and rejects seed-only shuffle input.

assignment.Index: current actual scene PlayerInfoList successful-created count, not authored name/ordinal. Stored in Player raw+8 signed byte.
assignment.PlayerIndex: selected scene index-list byte; native zero-extends to0..255 for FindGamePlayerInfo and Creator argument, Player.Initialize raw+e stores signed byte.
assignment.ColorIndex: color byte from FIRST GamePlayerInfo whose full raw PlayerRef==unsigned PlayerIndex+1. Creator passes byte; Player.Initialize raw+7 stores signed byte.
assignment.rawRef: GamePlayerInfo.PlayerRef is native 1-based raw int32; Init index scratch uses raw-1; null/stale/aliased refs are not repaired by authored-order fallback.
assignment.limit: Only scene bit2 triggers early skip when created count>=indexList.count. With bit2 off, out-of-range QList access throws; no modulo/wrap.
assignment.failure: Missing FindGamePlayerInfo or null Player.CreateEntity returns0 and does not append to PlayerInfoList; same current count remains for next authored attempt. Native factory created-bit bookkeeping is independent and outside this helper.
assignment.duplicates: Native FindGamePlayerInfo chooses first duplicate. Helper preserves duplicates, including possible dummy duplicate; frozen PlayerBootstrap.compile rejects duplicate-index-list scopes, so caller may not silently deduplicate to force compatibility.
